guard: A real MeshAgent user spawn reaches the real Manager, records its requested model and follows the accepted goal.

mutations.name: omit the recorded model from the real spawn result
mutations.find: data: { ...(reply.data as Record<string, unknown> | undefined), model: recorded.model },
mutations.expectRed: first real spawn model pin matched requested 'sonnet'
mutations.cell: first real spawn model pin matched requested 'sonnet'

mutations.name: bypass accepted-goal following for the real user spawn
mutations.expectRed: first real spawn followed canonical goal to terminal
mutations.cell: first real spawn followed canonical goal to terminal

mutations.name: the host bearer function is ignored and the agent tries to exec a bearer command it does not have
mutations.expectRed: MeshAgent connected on the user-auth broker with a host bearer function
mutations.cell: MeshAgent connected on the user-auth broker with a host bearer function

mutations.name: a host-bearer agent sends a manager call through a missing bearer command
mutations.find:
if (!bearerCmd)
          return { ok: false, error: `${command}: this agent's bearer comes from its host, which issues no manager-call bearer, so manager operations are unavailable` };
mutations.expectRed: a host-bearer agent refuses manager calls with no manager-call bearer
mutations.cell: a host-bearer agent refuses manager calls with no manager-call bearer
